title: Lead plan
description: One lead's plan (lead agents design, "Who writes what"), at operations/leads/<lead>.json (route operations/lead/[id]); the file name avoids *.plan.json, which the evidence/eval-plan route matches. A lead is a role with a portfolio (packages/naive/template/governance/roles/<lead>.json). The plan names the lead, the functions of its portfolio it plans for, the telos measures it is bound to (foundation/telos measures[].id), its current bets, each citing measure ids and handoff ids, and how often it reviews them. A lead writes only this plan, decisions/* and operations/handoff/*; packages/naive/src/checks/check-team.mjs refuses a lead in a team plan with no plan binding a measure.

lead.description: The lead's role id, a role template with a portfolio; the file name without .json

portfolio.description: The functions this lead plans for, ids in packages/naive/src/functions/departments.json; within its role template's portfolio

measures.description: The telos measure ids (foundation/telos measures[].id) this lead is accountable for. One accountable lead per measure (lead agents design, default 1)

bets.description: What the lead is betting on now, in priority order; a lead granted set-priorities over its plan reorders them without a person (default 4)

statement.description: The bet in a sentence: what the lead expects the work to move

measures.description: The measure ids it serves, from the plan's measures

handoffs.description: The handoff ids (operations/handoffs/<id>.json) that carry its work, one per function involved

review_cadence.description: How often the lead reviews its bets against its measures

next_review.description: The date of the next review
